verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Motion has a live REST API but it's documented only for tasks/projects (motion-docs-1, motion-probe-rt-2, docs.usemotion.com/api-reference), with no mention of meeting-specific endpoints for checking availability, booking, rescheduling, or cancelling meetings, and no MCP server offering exists anywhere in the pack. The meeting-assistant features described (motion-docs-6..9,38) are dashboard/product features, not API/MCP-exposed capabilities.
